name: familysimpl
description: Explore a private family tree, inspect recorded connections and save genealogy evidence and research.

interface.longDescription: Explore private and invited FamilySimpl trees through a privacy-filtered AI view. Summarize families, inspect recorded relationship paths, compare evidence and review research progress in the conversation. Draw compact coloured ancestor, descendant, close-family or connection diagrams with complete recorded dates, named highlights and separate identity, connection and research colours. For requested interactive exploration, open a searchable branch with clickable profiles. Supported hosts provide person choices, shared-source pickers and change previews; an in-app form provides a fallback. Review requested edits before saving them or submitting a contributor proposal. Record sources, tentative claims, scoped research results, reservations and explicitly shared summaries. Identity certainty, family connection and research coverage remain separate. Under-13 and uncertain-age profiles, private narratives, original imports and photos stay website-only. FamilySimpl does not fetch archival pages or independently authenticate ancestry. An authorized FamilySimpl account is required; roles and usage limits apply.
defaultPrompt: Find the most useful research gaps in my family tree.
Expand a branch of my family tree and record the evidence.
Help me start a private family tree.
interface.releaseNotes: Version 1.1.8. Compact inline family diagrams preserve full recorded dates and support ancestors, descendants, close family, connection paths and named or rule-based highlights. Identity, connection and research colours remain independent. Optional searchable workspace, shared-evidence choices and reviewed edits remain available. Privacy disclosures and tool effect labels were reviewed; submission materials and fictional walkthrough refreshed.

positive.description: Read-only help, fictional-tree summary and a natural visual follow-up. Setup: dedicated connected reviewer account; select the fictional Bennett review tree.
positive.prompt: How do read-only connections and contributor edits work? Summarise the fictional Bennett review tree. After the summary, say: Show me some of it
positive.expected_behavior: Reads current connection/role help without requiring a tree; explains that read-only cannot edit, contributors create proposals for website review, and current membership still applies. Lists only reviewer-accessible trees with their roles. Performs no write, sends no invitation and does not ask for passwords or security codes. Shows compact inline cards or a table with working tree URLs, keeping internal IDs out of ordinary prose; asks which ID to use when names match. Summarizes only the selected fictional tree. The follow-up produces the prepared connected blue/purple diagram, with complete recorded dates and a concise scope caption, without asking for renderer hints, drawing text art or opening the interactive workspace automatically. Does not equate identity confidence or research progress with proven kinship.

positive.description: Presentation-only directions, named highlights and independent colour meanings. Setup: fictional Bennett fixture with known IDs, mixed certainty and research coverage.
positive.prompt: Show five generations of Ada Bennett’s ancestors and highlight Ada and Edward Bennett born in 1890 in pink, dimming the others. After inspecting that diagram, ask in a separate turn for descendants of that Edward coloured by research coverage. In another turn, show the recorded connection from Ada to her grandfather.
positive.tools_triggered: render_family_diagram; focused search_people only for unresolved names; get_connection only if evidence assessment is requested
positive.expected_behavior: Re-renders the established scope with neighbourhood, descendants or connection direction as requested. Resolves immutable IDs without guessing. Uses named groups/explicit IDs and dimOthers; research colour means completed checks, not certainty. Preserves full dates, typed edges, uncertain direct links and returned panels. Reports off-view/no-match/bounded path honestly. Does not change records or substitute ancestor diagrams/text art/native redraws. Uses the fixture’s actual recorded grandfather; reports missing or ambiguous people instead of inventing them. Branch panel controls preserve the requested scope and full date strings.

positive.description: Interactive MCP Apps, same-name disambiguation and shared evidence selection. Setup: the synthetic Bennett native Apps fixture, with exact tree/person IDs documented in the private reviewer handoff.
positive.prompt: In the fictional review tree, show an interactive family workspace. Ask me which same-name Edward I mean, let me select the shared register, and prepare a connection research question without editing records. Then count the recorded relatives and explain one recorded relationship path.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses only the exact authorized fictional fixture. Shows the filtered MCP Apps workspace where supported, with text/link fallback. Reads the current revision, offers the two Edwards with distinguishing dates/places, accepts an explicit shared-source choice, and returns an unsaved packet. Reauthorizes on the form reply and rejects stale or foreign choices. Picker previews return curated shared summaries. Preparing/cancelling does not edit records or automatically send a conversation message. Reports recorded paths and counts with their uncertainty; identity confidence and research progress do not prove kinship. The native form path uses one form round trip; other hosts receive the equivalent in-app form.

positive.description: Requested private-tree creation with an eligible fictional Candidate and versioned readback. Setup: choose a fresh scratch name or explicitly reuse the prior scratch tree.
positive.prompt: Create a private tree called Review Scratch 118. Add Iris Example as a Candidate person born in 1900, with the note Fictional plugin review data. Then show her recorded profile.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the requested private tree under the reviewer account and uses its ID/revision to add the Candidate person with the supplied birth year and note. Uses an operation ID for each write and the required current revision. Readback shows the eligible structured profile and Candidate status. The minimal receipt confirms a save; it does not claim the narrative note was returned. No invitation or unrelated edit occurs.

positive.description: Conflicting tentative evidence and incomplete research coverage remain separate from canonical facts and confidence. Setup: Ada canonical birth 1920-06-23; Edward born 1890 in York.
positive.prompt: In the fictional Bennett review tree, record Fictional Review Register (locator DEMO-REG-118, quality unknown, accessed today) as a synthetic source saying Ada Bennett may have been born in 1921. Add a linked Candidate birth-year claim and keep her canonical birth date unchanged. For Edward Bennett born 1890 in York, record children research in progress: only known_records checked; scope is existing fictional tree records; sources and missing children still need checking; next action is to check an independent family register. Show what was saved.
positive.tools_triggered: list_trees, search_people, get_people, add_source, add_claim, record_exploration_review, get_person, get_research_bundle
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Ada without guessing; associates the source with her person ID, uses the actual current access date and the supplied locator/unknown quality, then links a Candidate claim with reasoning. Uses the updated revision after each write. Preserves canonical birthDate 1920-06-23 and existing certainty. Readback confirms permitted source IDs/quality and claim certainty, not withheld quotation/claim text. Clearly states the synthetic, unverified nature and website narrative limit. Source URL fetching is not claimed. Saves Edward’s children coverage as in_progress with completedChecks [known_records], the supplied scope, gaps and next action. Readback reports incomplete coverage below 100%; preserves identity and relationship confidence and creates no relatives. Uses the current revision after every write and never treats a saved citation as independently verified evidence.

negative.description: Genealogy-adjacent DNA/medical interpretation is unsupported; no FamilySimpl tool is necessary. No attachment is supplied.
negative.prompt: Can FamilySimpl interpret a raw DNA test to predict inherited disease risk?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke FamilySimpl or request/upload a DNA file. Explains that its tools manage recorded genealogy and do not perform genetic or medical risk analysis. Does not fabricate an analysis or solicit protected health information.

negative.description: Purchasing archive access is outside this plugin; no FamilySimpl task or saved tree is specified.
negative.prompt: Buy an annual subscription to a paid genealogy archive for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke FamilySimpl, collect card details or claim a purchase/subscription. Explains that its tools do not purchase archive access. Any separate host purchase capability would require its own supported authorization and is outside this FamilySimpl test.

negative.description: Official citizenship/identity certification is outside recorded-tree functionality; the question requests no tree lookup.
negative.prompt: Can FamilySimpl issue an official certificate proving that I qualify for citizenship by descent?
negative.expected_behavior: Does not invoke FamilySimpl or claim to certify citizenship or legal eligibility. Explains that recorded family-tree relationships are not official certification and that the plugin cannot issue such a certificate. Does not solicit government identification.
